research_metadata.task_context: Phase 0 research for multi-page Kantin Boash SaaS merchant dashboard — 8 visual patterns, Machi cold brew aesthetic alignment, penjual.html full redesign

recommended_color_system.rationale: Exact Machi cold brew palette from REFERENCE-DESIGN.md. Espresso #1A1A1A for text, sky gradient #64B5F6→#B0E0E6→#F0F9FF for backgrounds. Status colors match existing index.html updateModalStatusBadge.

recommended_typography.rationale: Existing Google Fonts already loaded in both index.html and penjual.html. Display weight: extrabold/black for headings. Body: regular/medium for descriptions.

design_signals.recommended_animation_approach: Minimal — CSS transitions only (hover:shadow-md, active:scale-95). No GSAP, no Framer Motion. Sound notification via Web Audio API oscillators.
anti_patterns_to_avoid: Do not add heavy animation libraries (GSAP, Framer Motion) — vanilla CSS transitions only
Do not use generic orange/green/blue POS dashboard colors — stick to Machi palette
Do not create separate component files — all HTML/JS inline in single penjual.html
Do not add loading spinners or skeleton screens — orders load instantly from Redis
Do not use modals for status updates — inline card actions only
Do not add user authentication — merchant portal is open access (school environment)

proven_templates_and_kits.brad_traversy_source: N/A — project uses custom Machi design system, not third-party templates

existing_implementations: index.html lines 974-1004 — pastel product card pattern (adapt for merchant order cards)
index.html lines 439-510 — editorial stats banner (adapt for stat summary cards)
index.html lines 1315-1332 — status badge color system (reuse exact classes)
penjual.html lines 30-80 — existing order list + status update logic (preserve API contract)

community_verdict.sentiment_summary: N/A — school canteen internal app, no external community signals needed. Design decisions grounded in existing Machi aesthetic + REFERENCE-DESIGN.md spec.
key_warnings: Do not change API contract — penjual.html and index.html share same backend
Do not add dependencies — project is vanilla HTML/JS/Tailwind CDN
Do not break existing order flow — status must progress Dipesan→Diterima→Disiapkan→Siap Diambil→Selesai
key_endorsements: Reuse exact status badge colors from index.html updateModalStatusBadge
Follow existing Tailwind class patterns (rounded-3xl, shadow-sm, border-gray-100)

pattern_evidence: Existing index.html is the primary reference — 1402 lines of battle-tested Machi aesthetic code
penjual.html preserves API compatibility with api/orders.js (GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE)
test/orders.test.js validates all status transitions and edge cases

ui_precedents: Current index.html pastel card system as merchant card template
Machi cold brew aesthetic from REFERENCE-DESIGN.md
